location_qualifier: assembled south of Périers; point = Périers
current_activity: forming the LXXXIV Corps reserve, assembled south of Périers behind the 5th Parachute Division
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 12 p. 227 gives the German order of battle on the morning of 24 July 1944, the day before the Cobra bombardment: the tired 353d Division, forming the LXXXIV Corps reserve, was assembled south of Périers and behind the 5th Parachute Division. Location: south of Périers. Location approximate: the Green Book gives the sector, not the command post of the unit.

location_qualifier: Dives crossing at Moissy, near Chambois
current_activity: 353rd Division breakout across the Dives in the Chambois area at Moissy; Mahlmann reaches Mt. Ormel
notes: Event date: Breakout and Pursuit ch. 27 p. 547-548: the division assembled in the woods near Vorche on the evening of 19 August; at daybreak on 20 August Mahlmann's column, near Chambois, crossed the Dives at Moissy and then occupied the southern part of Mt. Ormel without opposition; late in the afternoon it fell back three miles east behind the Vie. Location: Chambois area; the source names Moissy for the crossing. Location approximate: Moissy is not in the place list; the point is Chambois. Commander: Generalleutnant Paul Mahlmann (ch. 27 p. 547). Relationship: Meindl planned the breakout with his two divisions, the 3d Parachute and the 353d (p. 538).
